title: chapter-writer graph node
description: A single node in the chapter-writer knowledge graph: a Document, Paragraph, Artifact, Question, or Decision.

id.description: Stable, allocation-based node id (e.g. P-0001, IMG-0001, FLOW-0001, TABLE-0001, CODE-0001, Q-0001, DEC-0001).

document_id.description: Identity of the owning document: DOC:<normalized workspace-relative path>.

content.description: Node text content; for artifacts, the textual description or source form (never a replacement for the original artifact).

heading.description: Section heading the node falls under, when applicable.

position.description: 1-based ordinal position of the node within its document.

content_hash.description: Stable hash of the node content, used for change detection.

version.description: Content version number, incremented on each update.

status.description: Node lifecycle status (e.g. active, draft, archived).

metadata.description: Free-form metadata. Artifact nodes store their subtype under metadata.subtype.

subtype.description: Artifact subtype; required for Artifact nodes.

provenance.description: Provenance references: source document(s), origin nodes, or external citations.
